source_cell.conclusion: No ELM efficiency advantage; ELM withdrawn by user. Faithful old GRU has poor current taught acquisition too; global gradient connection was checked, not a unique cause established.

stream_transfer.scope: Repeated raw-byte addition then multiplication, not mixed four-operation qualification.
stream_transfer.conclusion: Taught recall can reach 100% after extensive repetition while held multiplication and addition after multiplication remain weak.

v3.scope: Ten short-budget technical recipes and a full-budget G0 fixture; no formal efficacy confirmation.
v3.conclusion: Extra tied cycles, new persistent modulation and naive wider recurrence did not establish gains in these recipes; baseline showed content errors rather than mainly EOS failure.

raw_rule.scope: Saved older model checkpoint inference and explicitly labelled posthoc oracle fits, not current SOURCE-CELL geometry.
raw_rule.conclusion: Common suffixes compressed cue distinctions; exact frozen-feature ridge still recalled poorly. More recurrent processing and one ridge tweak were not sufficient.
